1.web: When he opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
1.asv: And when he opened the seventh seal, there followed a silence in heaven about the space of half an hour.

2.web: I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given to them.
2.asv: And I saw the seven angels that stand before God; and there were given unto them seven trumpets.

3.web: Another angel came and stood over the altar, having a golden censer. Much incense was given to him, that he should add it to the prayers of all the saints on the golden altar which was before the throne.
3.asv: And another angel came and stood over the altar, having a golden censer; and there was given unto him much incense, that he should add it unto the prayers of all the saints upon the golden altar which was before the throne.

4.web: The smoke of the incense, with the prayers of the saints, went up before God out of the angel’s hand.
4.asv: And the smoke of the incense, with the prayers of the saints, went up before God out of the angel’s hand.

5.web: The angel took the censer, and he filled it with the fire of the altar, and threw it on the earth. There followed thunders, sounds, lightnings, and an earthquake.
5.asv: And the angel taketh the censer; and he filled it with the fire of the altar, and cast it upon the earth: and there followed thunders, and voices, and lightnings, and an earthquake.

6.web: The seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.
6.asv: And the seven angels that had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.

7.web: The first sounded, and there followed hail and fire, mixed with blood, and they were thrown to the earth. One third of the earth was burnt up, and one third of the trees were burnt up, and all green grass was burnt up.
7.asv: And the first sounded, and there followed hail and fire, mingled with blood, and they were cast upon the earth: and the third part of the earth was burnt up, and the third part of the trees was burnt up, and all green grass was burnt up.

8.web: The second angel sounded, and something like a great burning mountain was thrown into the sea. One third of the sea became blood,
8.asv: And the second angel sounded, and as it were a great mountain burning with fire was cast into the sea: and the third part of the sea became blood;

9.web: and one third of the living creatures which were in the sea died. One third of the ships were destroyed.
9.asv: and there died the third part of the creatures which were in the sea, even they that had life; and the third part of the ships was destroyed.

10.web: The third angel sounded, and a great star fell from the sky, burning like a torch, and it fell on one third of the rivers, and on the springs of the waters.
10.asv: And the third angel sounded, and there fell from heaven a great star, burning as a torch, and it fell upon the third part of the rivers, and upon the fountains of the waters;

11.web: The name of the star is called “Wormwood.” One third of the waters became wormwood. Many people died from the waters, because they were made bitter.
11.asv: and the name of the star is called Wormwood: and the third part of the waters became wormwood; and many men died of the waters, because they were made bitter.

12.web: The fourth angel sounded, and one third of the sun was struck, and one third of the moon, and one third of the stars; so that one third of them would be darkened, and the day wouldn’t shine for one third of it, and the night in the same way.
12.asv: And the fourth angel sounded, and the third part of the sun was smitten, and the third part of the moon, and the third part of the stars; that the third part of them should be darkened, and the day should not shine for the third part of it, and the night in like manner.

13.web: I saw, and I heard an eagle, flying in mid heaven, saying with a loud voice, “Woe! Woe! Woe for those who dwell on the earth, because of the other voices of the trumpets of the three angels, who are yet to sound!”
13.asv: And I saw, and I heard an eagle, flying in mid heaven, saying with a great voice, Woe, woe, woe, for them that dwell on the earth, by reason of the other voices of the trumpet of the three angels, who are yet to sound.
